messages:
sam-sales: Heads-up: Ridgeview sent an RFI addendum asking for a POC pricing table, a short on-prem validation runbook, and our capability matrix with BYOK/HSM details. Form: https://files.redwood/rv/addendum.pdf. Need response by COB tomorrow.

rita-se: I can scope this. They want a 5-day POC and reproducible evals. We normally do 7 days but can compress if we limit to baseline perf and core integration. Will note exclusions.

carlos-solutions: Pricing sketch: per-GPU/day (p4d-equivalent), eng support $/day, one-time HSM integration fee, optional extension daily rate. I'll produce a line-item sheet.

maya-sre: Ops: Dedicated SLA 99.95% ok. Private installs: SLA only when Redwood manages control plane; otherwise we provide response SLAs. I'll add an install checklist and a minimal config snippet for the runbook.

ben-legal: We'll avoid open-ended liquidated damages. Recommend service credits capped at a percentage of monthly fees and a mutual NDA for the sanitized eval set. I'll upload redlines.

file-bot: File uploaded: ridgeview_capability_v1.xlsx (by sam-sales)

rita-se: Tech asks to add: BYOK + HSM options, quantization tradeoffs with sample latencies (fp16, int8, q4) at 512 tokens, and fallback routing note.

carlos-solutions: Adding Optimize presets (auto-batch + KV cache) under cost controls and a latency table.

maya-sre: Runbook snippet for Private minimal config:

```
redwood_controlplane:
  mode: managed
  region: eu-west-1
nodes:
  - type: p4d
    count: 2
autoscale:
  min: 1
  target_cpu_pct: 70
```

sam-sales: Action items: Carlos updates capability matrix with HSM/BYOK + latency table, Rita prepares sanitized eval and reproducibility README, Maya adds runbook & autoscale table, Ben provides legal redlines. I'll collate and send tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
